request.goal: Reduce the source's diagnostic maximum-rank summed NCCL kernel duration for the accumulated training step, retaining its step-time constraint and full correctness checks.

source.source_reduction: per-rank sum of NCCL kernel durations in a separately profiled step, maximum across ranks, median of the 3 profiled samples

notes: User command: torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 gpt2_ddp_training.py --output /tmp/original-ddp --profile; README.md:37 documents the equivalent python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 form. The command sets no --warmup/--repeats, so common.py:24-25 defaults (2 warmup, 5 clean repeats) apply.

Objective is the diagnostic communication metric requested in the goal, distinct from the end-to-end step time: per-rank summed device NCCL kernel duration of the accumulated step, max over ranks, median of 3 separately profiled iterations (--profile, gpt2_ddp_training.py:121-125,156-157). Per workloads.json communication_metric_caveat it includes device waiting and is not wire time, critical-path time or exposed communication; the source also reports profiling perturbation.

Mapped to the installed deployment.json metric collector torch_communication field communication_kernel_sum_ms (unit ms, per-rank sum of device communication-kernel durations in a separately profiled invocation) with max rank aggregation; collector availability must be verified by the actual workload worker.

Constraint (performance, not correctness): clean step time, max over ranks and median of the 5 clean repeats, must remain <= 1.05x baseline; source notation goals[1].constraints.step_ms_max_baseline_ratio=1.05 in workloads.json, restated in README.md:48.

Quality: FP32 model, TF32 disabled and float32 matmul precision 'highest' (common.py:34-42). Full gradients are compared against a rank-0 serial single-device reference that consumes the exact global batch (8 samples, 1024 tokens) with grad atol=1e-6/rtol=1e-4 (gpt2_ddp_training.py:68-78); post-update parameters with atol=1e-6/rtol=1e-4 (lines 88-91); loss asserted finite (line 65); negative +1-corruption control must be rejected (line 78).

Exact discrete comparison: every rank's full gradients must equal the rank-0 replica exactly via torch.testing.assert_close(atol=0.0, rtol=0.0) on broadcast tensors (gpt2_ddp_training.py:81-86); optimizer state/step semantics: SGD lr=0.001, momentum=0, weight_decay=0, foreach=False (line 60).

Baseline communication behavior to preserve: first 3 of 4 micro-batches under DDP.no_sync(), single gradient reduction per step; DDP(broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True) (gpt2_ddp_training.py:40,59). The separate inventory comm hook (bucket bytes/call counts, gpt2_ddp_training.py:128-142) is a diagnostic outside clean timing and the measured invocation.

Timing boundaries: step time is per-rank wall time of step() after cuda synchronize and a gloo control-group barrier; ranks are not summed (gpt2_ddp_training.py:111-119,150-152). The gloo group (barrier, all_gather_object) is auxiliary process control, not part of the measured NCCL workload.
Inputs and weights are seeded synthetic fixtures (torch.manual_seed(20261020) init; token IDs from generator seed 31000+rank), so no external model weights or datasets are needed.

One measured invocation: One accumulated GPT-2 DDP training step per rank: optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True); forward+backward over the 4 seeded micro-batches of shape (micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128) with the first 3 under model.no_sync() and the gradient allreduce on the final micro-batch; SGD(lr=0.001) optimizer.step(); torch.cuda.synchronize(). Each measured unit starts from the fixed seed-20261020 initial weights (harness restores state outside the timed region). Reference construction, correctness checks, statistical warmup/repeats, the profile wrapper, the bucket-inventory hook run and report writing are measurement infrastructure outside this invocation.
